fact_previews: Colorkeys is a project aimed at helping kids learn piano and read music using a color-based method.
Colorkeys was conceived more than ten years ago by a teacher.
The teacher wanted to pass on his love of piano and music to his students.
Traditional music classes for an hour a week often resulted in frustration rather than enjoyment for most kids.
Colorkeys was invented to quickly teach full classes of students how to play piano and read music in a fun and engaging way.

fact_previews: Colorkeys is based on a patented color-coded note system where music and notes are represented in colors that correspond to colored stickers used on music keys.
Colorkeys helps kids quickly make the connection between the notes on the page and the keys on the keyboard.
Using the Colorkeys method, kids can begin to learn in a few hours what usually takes months of lessons to achieve.
The Colorkeys program was developed into a software program designed to aid a teacher in a classroom setting.
The program allows kids to learn at their own pace and provides instant feedback and rewards to promote learning.

fact_previews: The Colorkeys method aims to make music education available to children everywhere at an affordable cost.
Colorkeys is developing an engaging music-based video game to help children learn how to play, read, and enjoy music.
The video game is designed to be both fun and based on sound academic principles.
The game will require children to complete tasks and stages before advancing to more material.
A point system in the game will encourage children to finish activities and play accurately.

fact_previews: The project aims to enhance music education and make it accessible to everyone.
The project will use the developed game to support school music education.
For every 100 games sold, a Colorkeys school program package will be donated to a school in need.
The Colorkeys school program package includes educational software, up to 30 digital keyboards, educational materials, and teacher training.
The project seeks support to develop the game.
